postTitle: Scott! C'mon man! (Not a negative post Just leverage!)
postSubject: Scott you told like 9 months ago that you would put this game on console and Not only me but the rest of the community have been waiting for this big milestones to happen. Can we at least get a update?
commentSubject: I can actually give an update on this. The reason why this has been slow moving is because it's probably the single most important deal that I could possibly make, and picking the correct game studio is critical. I've had to turn down several different companies, for different reasons. Sometimes because of me not getting full approval rights, and other times because I felt the company would simply take the series in the wrong direction.I've been negotiating with a new company however that I think has tremendous potential, so I'm very encouraged. I'm also glad that I waited. Giving the wrong company a license would be reckless, and a huge disservice to the fanbase.
